checks.details: All benchmark, empirical, and ablation JSON outputs contain strictly valid finite float metrics.
Master manifest verified with 60 distinct operational disaster tiles.
Leave-one-event-out matrix strictly enforces disjoint geographic boundaries between training and test sets.
All vector building geometries verified with Shapely is_valid check; no self-intersections.
Vector boundaries standardized to EPSG:4326 (WGS 84); raster projections aligned to native UTM zones.
Bi-temporal pairs strictly standardized to (512, 512, 3) optical channels.
Building identifiers are strictly unique within each scenario namespace.
Processed tiles verified without decoding errors.

checks.check: Explicit Label Quality Separation (EXACT vs WEAK)
checks.details: Ground truth is explicitly labeled as EXACT (verified field survey) or WEAK (hazard boundary overlay). Zero synthetic labels created.
5 core checkpoints verified physically on disk (>1MB each, total params audited).
